key_id.description: Optional provider key UUID. When supplied, models reachable with that specific key are returned (useful for Azure OpenAI, where the deployment list depends on the configured endpoint). A key belongs to exactly one provider, so `provider` may be omitted alongside it; when both are given they must agree.

provider.description: LLM provider to list models for. Omit it to list every supported provider and its models in one call.
